name: ibis Styles Mayotte Aéroport
desc: Nestled in a leafy park, eyes fixed on the surrounding ocean, your spirit soothed by the island scenery-welcome to Mayotte! Elegantly styled in harmony with the local ecosystem, the hotel has a terrace overlooking the pool, a fitness center and meeting areas. Watch the sea turtles at play and unwind in the safe tranquility at the ibis Styles de Mayotte, where you'll want to return to again and again.
